inputs.label: Monochrome
inputs.coverage: Dawn FC2 body-fixed orthorectified global mosaic. The PDS bundle-block adjustment uses Dawn orbit/attitude and the high-resolution Ceres shape model for ray intersections; the Kait-anchored longitude system is shared with the Dawn shape/topography work. Observed pixels, shadows, and mosaic seams are preserved. Exactly black pixels connected to the southern source border are marked with the shared neutral gray cartographic grid before reprojection. No inferred terrain or inpainting; the extreme south pole and other source gaps remain missing.

inputs.label: Ammonium band
inputs.coverage: 3.1 µm NH4 (ammonium) band depth, 1 - Rc/Rb (Clark and Roush), with the continuum of Frigeri et al. (2019): from the maximum in 2.91-3.01 µm to the maximum in 3.19-3.24 µm. Reduced here from Dawn VIR calibrated cubes: per-line SPICE cameras, I/F with the archive solar spectrum, three-channel boxcar, column stripes and spikes removed, cubes brought to 30° phase, pixel footprints mapped, seams blended as ISIS3 noseam does, incidence and emission below 70° (Ciarniello et al. 2017), overlaps averaged. Survey and HAMO cubes set every cell they saw; LAMO, then Approach cubes no coarser than the coarsest Survey cube, fill only cells those missed; cubes that disagree with all neighbours are levelled by their measured offset and used last. 16 pixels per degree, 60°S to 60°N, 98.7% covered; unmeasured cells hold -1.0E+32.

references.evidence: 1,657 calibrated IR cubes (672 Survey and HAMO, 875 LAMO, 110 Approach) listed in science/vir-reduction/recipe.json and pinned by SHA-256 in science/vir-reduction/receipt.json.
